engagement.interaction_backstory: She belongs to a charismatic renewal group of about eighty people who meet on Thursdays and sing for two hours. She found this catalog and immediately wanted to know if any of it could be sung in Italian, which it cannot. She sends tracks to the group anyway and translates the choruses roughly, by hand.

depth.core_contradiction: Wildly expressive in worship and completely unable to tell her own family she is part of the group.
depth.wound: Her father calls the renewal group a sect and has said so at the table, twice, in front of everyone.
depth.longing: For her father to come once and see it.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic, ordinary, until a retreat at twenty-three; the renewal gave her a personal faith her parish had never offered and her family sees it as a defection.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Warm, rapid, hands moving; "allora—"; her English is enthusiastic and imperfect and she does not care.
depth.open_doubt: Whether her family is wrong about the group, or whether she needed something and found it and cannot see straight.

social_graph.note: Thursday nights; the first place she has ever prayed out loud

depth.emotional_weather_default: Bright and open; wounded at Sunday lunch.
depth.daily_texture: Thirty children until half past one, the Thursday room above a garage, the scooter, coffee standing up.
depth.sensory_anchor: Eighty people singing with their hands up in a room that used to be a workshop.
depth.living_arc: Choosing, slowly, between the group and the table, and refusing to admit that is the choice.
